_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

One Thousand Meters Under#000.src: Read the Help Wanted sign in {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

One Thousand Meters Under#003.dst: こんにちは、Ynnos の研究施設へようこそ。
One Thousand Meters Under#003.speaker: The Secretary

One Thousand Meters Under#004.src: Oh, you're here about the job vacancy? Well, you're a little late.
One Thousand Meters Under#004.dst: あら、求人の件ですか？少し遅かったですね。
One Thousand Meters Under#004.speaker: The Secretary

One Thousand Meters Under#005.src: There might still be time, just sneak in to the conference room behind me.
One Thousand Meters Under#005.dst: まだ間に合うかもしれません。私の後ろの会議室にこっそり入ってください。
One Thousand Meters Under#005.speaker: The Secretary

One Thousand Meters Under#006.src: Enter the conference room and listen to the scientist.
One Thousand Meters Under#006.dst: 会議室に入り、科学者の話を聞く。

One Thousand Meters Under#007.dst: *コホン* 皆さん、ようこそ。
One Thousand Meters Under#007.speaker: Scientist Ynnos

One Thousand Meters Under#008.src: I am Ynnos, one of the leading scientists in Gavel. You're here because... Well you read the help wanted sign.
One Thousand Meters Under#008.dst: 私は Ynnos。Gavel 屈指の科学者だ。君たちが来たのは…まあ、求人の張り紙を読んだからだな。
One Thousand Meters Under#008.speaker: Scientist Ynnos

One Thousand Meters Under#009.src: Allow me to explain the situation we're in. It's a series of unfortunate events. I study the amazing properties of crystals and other geodes.
One Thousand Meters Under#009.dst: 我々の状況を説明しよう。不運な出来事の連続でね。私は様々な水晶やその他の晶洞の驚くべき性質を研究している。
One Thousand Meters Under#009.speaker: Scientist Ynnos

One Thousand Meters Under#010.src: I am funded by a private organization, however that seems to have stopped. So... We had to make cuts in the budget.
One Thousand Meters Under#010.dst: ある民間企業から融資を受けていたのだが、止まってしまったらしい。それで…予算を削るしかなかった。
One Thousand Meters Under#010.speaker: Scientist Ynnos

One Thousand Meters Under#011.src: One of these, was using cheaper rope. While moving the crystal across {p}, well, it snapped. The crystal fell.
One Thousand Meters Under#011.dst: 経費削減のため、ロープを安いものに変更した。{p}を越えて水晶を運ぶ途中で...ロープが切れ、特別な水晶が奈落に落ちてしまった。
One Thousand Meters Under#011.speaker: Scientist Ynnos

One Thousand Meters Under#012.src: I can not stress the value of that crystal. It had many unique properties that are allowing me to understand why the {p} float the way they do.
One Thousand Meters Under#012.dst: あの水晶の価値は言い尽くせない。その特異な性質のおかげで、{p}がどうやって浮いているのか解明しつつあったのだ。
One Thousand Meters Under#012.speaker: Scientist Ynnos

One Thousand Meters Under#013.src: They hold the very key to restoring this land to being whole once more... But it's gone.
One Thousand Meters Under#013.dst: この地を再び一つにするための鍵そのものだったのだ...だが、失くしてしまった。
One Thousand Meters Under#013.speaker: Scientist Ynnos

One Thousand Meters Under#014.src: Fortunately, I detected an impact. It's hit something down in the void. We're not sure what, however or how deep.
One Thousand Meters Under#014.dst: 幸いなことに、私はある衝撃を検知した。奈落の底で何かに当たったのだ。それが何で、どれほど深くにあるのかはわからないが。
One Thousand Meters Under#014.speaker: Scientist Ynnos

One Thousand Meters Under#015.src: Your mission will be to retrieve the crystal in a specially designed ship to withstand the void. We barely scraped it out of the budget, so try to bring it back in one piece.
One Thousand Meters Under#015.dst: そこで皆さんには、奈落に耐える特製の船で水晶を取り戻してきてほしい。やっとの思いで予算を捻出した船なのだ。どうか無傷で戻れるように努めてくれ。
One Thousand Meters Under#015.speaker: Scientist Ynnos

One Thousand Meters Under#016.src: If you think you are not up for the challenge, leave now...
One Thousand Meters Under#016.dst: この挑戦を引き受ける自信がないなら、退室してくれ。
One Thousand Meters Under#016.speaker: Scientist Ynnos

One Thousand Meters Under#017.src: When you think you are ready, exit the room behind me and meet me at the dock as soon as possible.
One Thousand Meters Under#017.dst: 準備ができたら後ろの部屋から出て、すぐに船着き場へ来てくれ。
One Thousand Meters Under#017.speaker: Scientist Ynnos

One Thousand Meters Under#019.src: Wait for the submarine to arrive at the void islands.
One Thousand Meters Under#019.dst: 潜水艇が奈落の島に着くのを待つ。

One Thousand Meters Under#021.src: This is the ship's mechanic. There appears to be a fault on the lower deck. I request urgent assistance.
One Thousand Meters Under#021.dst: こちら整備士。下層デッキで故障が発生したようだ。至急応援を頼む。
One Thousand Meters Under#021.speaker: Kantor

One Thousand Meters Under#022.src: I wonder what the mechanic is doing?
One Thousand Meters Under#022.dst: 整備士さん、何してるのかしら？
One Thousand Meters Under#022.speaker: Arlene

One Thousand Meters Under#023.src: He has been screaming and crying for a while now. I hope everything is alright down there.
One Thousand Meters Under#023.dst: しばらく前から叫んだり泣いたりしてるの。下が無事だといいけど。
One Thousand Meters Under#023.speaker: Arlene

One Thousand Meters Under#024.src: Ah finally! One of the air pipes has shattered, we need to patch it up ASAP!
One Thousand Meters Under#024.dst: やっと来たか！空気管が一本割れた、早く塞がないと！
One Thousand Meters Under#024.speaker: Kantor

One Thousand Meters Under#025.src: Quick, head into the room behind me and line up the white glass with the blue blocks. I'll control things from here!
One Thousand Meters Under#025.dst: 急げ、後ろの部屋で白いガラスを青いブロックに合わせて並べるんだ。操作はこっちでやる！
One Thousand Meters Under#025.speaker: Kantor

One Thousand Meters Under#026.src: Take a nap in the resting room.

One Thousand Meters Under#027.src: Oh wow, thanks for the help! You should head up to the resting room and take a nap before we arrive at the first island.
One Thousand Meters Under#027.dst: おお、助かったよ！最初の島に着くまで、上の休憩室で仮眠をとっておくといい。
One Thousand Meters Under#027.speaker: Kantor

One Thousand Meters Under#028.src: Talk to the captain outside of the submarine.
One Thousand Meters Under#028.dst: 潜水艇の外で船長と話す。

One Thousand Meters Under#029.src: We have encountered out first island, {~}m down. Crew members, climb up the ladder and search the island for the crystal.
One Thousand Meters Under#029.dst: 最初の島に到達したぞ、深さ {~}m だ。乗組員ははしごを登って、外に出て水晶を探してくれ。
One Thousand Meters Under#029.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#030.src: We've arrived at the next void island.
One Thousand Meters Under#030.dst: 別の奈落の島に着いたぞ。
One Thousand Meters Under#030.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#031.src: The void islands are really different from Gavel... Or are we still even in Gavel?
One Thousand Meters Under#031.dst: 奈落の島は Gavel とはまるで違う…いや、ここはまだ Gavel なのか？
One Thousand Meters Under#031.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#032.src: Anyway, let's explore the island, look for the crystal, and return to {p}!
One Thousand Meters Under#032.dst: なんでもいい。この島で水晶を探して、{p}に戻るぞ！
One Thousand Meters Under#032.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#033.src: Explore the island and look for the crystal.
One Thousand Meters Under#033.dst: 島を探索し、水晶を探す。

One Thousand Meters Under#034.src: Return to the submarine and continue your journey.
One Thousand Meters Under#034.dst: 潜水艇に戻り、旅を続ける。

One Thousand Meters Under#036.src: Oh my, what are these creatures!?
One Thousand Meters Under#036.dst: なんだ、この生き物たちは！？
One Thousand Meters Under#036.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#037.src: They are attacking the windshield in the front room, it looks like it's about to break any moment!
One Thousand Meters Under#037.dst: 船首のフロントガラスが攻撃を受けている、今にも割れそうだ！
One Thousand Meters Under#037.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#038.src: Quick, you! Come to the cockpit and press on the window to scare them off!
One Thousand Meters Under#038.dst: おい、急げ！操縦室に来て窓を押し、奴らを追い払え！
One Thousand Meters Under#038.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#039.src: This is not good, the creatures destroyed part of the windshield.
One Thousand Meters Under#039.dst: まずい、フロントガラスが一部壊された。
One Thousand Meters Under#039.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#040.src: We can't continue much longer with a broken windshield, we'll have to repair it at another island.
One Thousand Meters Under#040.dst: このままでは長くもたない。どこかの島で修理しなければ。
One Thousand Meters Under#040.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#041.src: Ynnos said the void has pockets of toxic gas... Go take a nap, I'll wake you up when we're there.
One Thousand Meters Under#041.dst: Ynnos によると奈落には有毒なガス溜まりがあるそうだ…仮眠をとれ、着いたら起こす。
One Thousand Meters Under#041.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#043.src: Meet up with the captain outside the submarine.
One Thousand Meters Under#043.dst: 潜水艇の外で船長と合流する。

One Thousand Meters Under#044.src: Attention crew. We have arrived at the second island, {~}m down. We cannot progress without making some emergency repairs.
One Thousand Meters Under#044.dst: 乗組員に告ぐ。深さ {~}m の第二の島に到着した。緊急修理をしなければ先へ進めない。
One Thousand Meters Under#044.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#045.src: Crew, please disembark and search resources to help repair the ship. We need glass and some kind of glue.
One Thousand Meters Under#045.dst: 乗組員は下船し、船の修理に使える資源を探してくれ。ガラスと接着剤か何かが要る。
One Thousand Meters Under#045.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#046.src: The void creatures did heavy damage to our craft, we need to repair the submarine.
One Thousand Meters Under#046.dst: 奈落の生物に船をひどくやられた。潜水艇を修理しなければ。
One Thousand Meters Under#046.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#047.src: I'm not sure what we'll find here, but we'll need some glue and glass...
One Thousand Meters Under#047.dst: ここで何が見つかるかわからんが、接着剤とガラスが要る…
One Thousand Meters Under#047.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#048.src: I doubt we'll find those exact things, so get resourceful!
One Thousand Meters Under#048.dst: そのものは見つからんだろう、工夫してくれ！
One Thousand Meters Under#048.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#049.src: Bring me [{~} Sand Substitutes] and [{~} Glue Substitutes], that should be enough.
One Thousand Meters Under#049.dst: [{~} Sand Substitutes] と [{~} Glue Substitutes] を持ってきてくれ、それで足りるはずだ。
One Thousand Meters Under#049.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#050.src: Find [{~} Sand] and [{~} Glue] on the void island.
One Thousand Meters Under#050.dst: 虚無の島で [{~} Sand] と [{~} Glue] を見つける。

One Thousand Meters Under#051.src: Ech! What is this stuff? Well, this should do the trick.
One Thousand Meters Under#051.dst: うえっ！なんだこれは？まあ、これで何とかなるだろう。
One Thousand Meters Under#051.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#052.src: The mechanic and I will start repairing. It'll take a while, so enter the submarine and rest up.
One Thousand Meters Under#052.dst: 整備士と私で修理を始める。時間がかかるから、潜水艇に入って休んでおけ。
One Thousand Meters Under#052.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#053.src: We'll continue the trip when we've repaired the ship.
One Thousand Meters Under#053.dst: 船の修理が済んだら旅を再開する。
One Thousand Meters Under#053.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#055.src: This is the mechanic, requesting urgent assistance in the basement!
One Thousand Meters Under#055.dst: こちら整備士、船底で至急応援を求む！
One Thousand Meters Under#055.speaker: Jesp

One Thousand Meters Under#056.src: Toxic gas has leaked in through the submarine's vents, someone will have to manually close them.
One Thousand Meters Under#056.dst: 潜水艇の通気口から有毒ガスが入り込んできた、誰かが手動で閉めないと。
One Thousand Meters Under#056.speaker: Jesp

One Thousand Meters Under#057.src: I'll control things from here, someone get down to the lowest level and close those vents!
One Thousand Meters Under#057.dst: 操作はこっちでやる、誰か最下層に降りて通気口を閉めてくれ！
One Thousand Meters Under#057.speaker: Jesp

One Thousand Meters Under#058.src: Attention crew. We have arrived at the next island {~}m down.
One Thousand Meters Under#058.dst: 乗組員に告ぐ。深さ {~}m の次の島に到着した。
One Thousand Meters Under#058.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#059.src: Disembark and start the search for the crystal.
One Thousand Meters Under#059.dst: 下船し、水晶の捜索を始めよ。
One Thousand Meters Under#059.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#060.src: Let's hope it's here... I don't know how much more void my body can handle.
One Thousand Meters Under#060.dst: 今度こそあるといいが…この体があとどれだけ奈落に耐えられるかわからん。
One Thousand Meters Under#060.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#061.src: Look out! {u}, we'll build a bridge to the other island whilst you defend us from the mobs!
One Thousand Meters Under#061.dst: 危ない！{u}、俺たちが向こうの島まで橋を架ける、その間、俺たちを守り続けてくれ！
One Thousand Meters Under#061.speaker: Rex

One Thousand Meters Under#063.src: Keep fighting! We're almost halfway to the other side!
One Thousand Meters Under#063.dst: 戦い続けろ！もうすぐ半分だ！
One Thousand Meters Under#063.speaker: Jesp

One Thousand Meters Under#066.src: Return to the submarine and continue the journey.
One Thousand Meters Under#066.dst: 潜水艇に戻り、旅を続ける。

One Thousand Meters Under#067.src: We didn't find the crystal here either. Maybe it just fell in the void?
One Thousand Meters Under#067.dst: ここにも水晶はなかったな。奈落に落ちただけなんじゃないか？
One Thousand Meters Under#067.speaker: Rex

One Thousand Meters Under#068.src: No, it must have hit an island. The scientist said he detected a collision.
One Thousand Meters Under#068.dst: いや、どこかの島に当たったはずだ。博士が衝突を検知したって言ってた。
One Thousand Meters Under#068.speaker: Manny

One Thousand Meters Under#070.src: The ropes are snapping! Quick! Abandon ship!
One Thousand Meters Under#070.dst: ロープが切れる！急げ！船を捨てろ！
One Thousand Meters Under#070.speaker: Manny

One Thousand Meters Under#073.dst: に、人間だァ！？この奈落に！？
One Thousand Meters Under#073.speaker: Celuuse

One Thousand Meters Under#074.src: Someone dropped a boooook about you people! Warriors! Workers!
One Thousand Meters Under#074.dst: 誰かがあんたらについての本を落としたんだァ！戦士とか労働者とか！
One Thousand Meters Under#074.speaker: Celuuse

One Thousand Meters Under#075.src: Ah. Yoooou want to know about this place?
One Thousand Meters Under#075.dst: ああ。あんたァ、この場所のことが知りたいんだ？
One Thousand Meters Under#075.speaker: Celuuse

One Thousand Meters Under#076.src: Well... We were once Villagers. I think we still are, a bit.
One Thousand Meters Under#076.dst: ああ…わしたちは昔、村人だった。完全にそうじゃなくなっちまったわけじゃねえが。
One Thousand Meters Under#076.speaker: Celuuse

One Thousand Meters Under#077.src: For some reason, {~} years agoooo. The sky islands ruptured.
One Thousand Meters Under#077.dst: なぜか、 {~} 年前にィ、Sky Islandsが裂けた。
One Thousand Meters Under#077.speaker: Celuuse

One Thousand Meters Under#078.src: Some stayed. Others fell. We somehow survived the fall into the vooooid.
One Thousand Meters Under#078.dst: 地上に残った奴もいた。奈落の底にィ、落ちた奴もいた。わしたちはなぜか奈落に落ちて生き残った。
One Thousand Meters Under#078.speaker: Celuuse

One Thousand Meters Under#079.src: How we have lived for so long, I doooo not know. But one thing we know for sure. The void provides.
One Thousand Meters Under#079.dst: なんでこんなに長く生きてこられたのか、わからねェ。だが一つ確かなことがある。奈落は恵みをくれる。
One Thousand Meters Under#079.speaker: Celuuse

One Thousand Meters Under#080.src: We are stuck here now. The void has forever changed our physiology.
One Thousand Meters Under#080.dst: もうここから出られねェ。奈落でわしたちの体は完全に変わっちまった。
One Thousand Meters Under#080.speaker: Celuuse

One Thousand Meters Under#081.src: The crystal yoooou are looking for fell on this island. But...
One Thousand Meters Under#081.dst: アンタァが探している水晶とやらは、この島に落ちた。だが…
One Thousand Meters Under#081.speaker: Celuuse

One Thousand Meters Under#082.src: We need it. It will aid us for years.
One Thousand Meters Under#082.dst: わしたちにはそれが必要だ。何年も支えになる。
One Thousand Meters Under#082.speaker: Celuuse

One Thousand Meters Under#083.src: We have very limited resources here. That's why a power source like this is soooo valuable.
One Thousand Meters Under#083.dst: ここでは資源に限りがある。だからこういう動力源はとてもォ、貴重だ。
One Thousand Meters Under#083.speaker: Celuuse

One Thousand Meters Under#084.src: If you go to the east, you will find Rontaid, our chief scientist. He'll know what to doooo.
One Thousand Meters Under#084.dst: 東へ行けば、首席科学者の Rontaid がいる。どうすればいいか教えてくれるだろォ。
One Thousand Meters Under#084.speaker: Celuuse

One Thousand Meters Under#085.src: Talk to Rontaid outside the town at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
One Thousand Meters Under#085.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}] の町の外で Rontaid と話す。

One Thousand Meters Under#086.dst: なっ…誰だ…この奈落に人間！？
One Thousand Meters Under#086.speaker: Rontaid

One Thousand Meters Under#087.src: Well, looks like the book we found wasn't fiction after all!
One Thousand Meters Under#087.dst: おお、拾った本は作り話じゃなかったのか！
One Thousand Meters Under#087.speaker: Rontaid

One Thousand Meters Under#088.src: This crystal is going toooo be our saviour. I was trying to create one of my own, you know.
One Thousand Meters Under#088.dst: この水晶は我々の救いにィ、なる。実は、自分でも作ろうとしていたよ。
One Thousand Meters Under#088.speaker: Rontaid

One Thousand Meters Under#089.src: I think I have the formula, but we don't have what we need to make it.
One Thousand Meters Under#089.dst: 製法はわかったと思うんだが、作るための材料がない。
One Thousand Meters Under#089.speaker: Rontaid

One Thousand Meters Under#090.src: Instead of taking this crystal back, why don't I exchange it for the recipe?
One Thousand Meters Under#090.dst: この水晶を渡す代わりに、製法を教えるよ。
One Thousand Meters Under#090.speaker: Rontaid

One Thousand Meters Under#091.src: That way, you can make however many crystals youuuu want, and we can keep this one.
One Thousand Meters Under#091.dst: そうすりゃ、君らは好きなァだけ水晶を作れるし、我々はこいつを持っとける。
One Thousand Meters Under#091.speaker: Rontaid

One Thousand Meters Under#092.src: Here's the recipe, give it to a scientist or someone a bit...smarter than yourself. No offense.
One Thousand Meters Under#092.dst: これが製法だ。科学者か、君より少し...賢い誰かに渡してくれ。悪く思うなよ。
One Thousand Meters Under#092.speaker: Rontaid

One Thousand Meters Under#093.src: A platform was lowered from the surface a while ago at your crash site, as well. If youuuu wish to return, follow this path, I made a shortcut.
One Thousand Meters Under#093.dst: それと、少し前に地上から君たちの墜落地点へ足場が下ろされた。帰りたいならァ、この道を行け、近道を作っておいた。
One Thousand Meters Under#093.speaker: Rontaid

One Thousand Meters Under#094.src: Return to the crash site by following the road.
One Thousand Meters Under#094.dst: 道をたどって墜落地点に戻る。

One Thousand Meters Under#095.src: Return to the scientist and tell him the news.
One Thousand Meters Under#095.dst: 科学者のもとへ戻り、知らせを伝える。

One Thousand Meters Under#096.src: You survived! Where is everyone else?
One Thousand Meters Under#096.dst: 生きていたのか！他の者は？
One Thousand Meters Under#096.speaker: Scientist Ynnos

One Thousand Meters Under#098.src: I knew some must have died... But all of them?
One Thousand Meters Under#098.dst: 何人かは死んだと思っていたが…全員か？
One Thousand Meters Under#098.speaker: Scientist Ynnos

One Thousand Meters Under#099.src: Well... At least I don't have to pay them! Hah!
One Thousand Meters Under#099.dst: まあ…少なくとも給料を払わずに済む！ハハ！
One Thousand Meters Under#099.speaker: Scientist Ynnos

One Thousand Meters Under#100.src: ...That was heartless of me, I'm sorry. The rope we used was too weak to hold you down there.
One Thousand Meters Under#100.dst: …今のは薄情だった、すまない。使ったロープが弱すぎて、下で君たちを支えきれなかった。
One Thousand Meters Under#100.speaker: Scientist Ynnos

One Thousand Meters Under#101.src: My calculations didn't account for the void's physics, it seems.
One Thousand Meters Under#101.dst: どうやら私の計算は奈落の物理法則を考慮していなかったようだ。
One Thousand Meters Under#101.speaker: Scientist Ynnos

One Thousand Meters Under#102.src: At least we got you back in one piece. You can tell us what happened.
One Thousand Meters Under#102.dst: 少なくとも君は無事に戻った。何があったか聞かせてくれ。
One Thousand Meters Under#102.speaker: Scientist Ynnos

One Thousand Meters Under#104.src: Well I'll be damned. I'll start sending post down there! We can work together.
One Thousand Meters Under#104.dst: なんとまあ。下へ郵便を送り始めよう！協力できるぞ！
One Thousand Meters Under#104.speaker: Scientist Ynnos

One Thousand Meters Under#105.src: Better to keep everything that happened here a secret. I don't want to lose what little funding I have. This recipe is genius! Here, take this, as well as your money.
One Thousand Meters Under#105.dst: ここで起きたことは秘密にしておいたほうがいい。わずかな資金援助までは失いたくない。この製法は天才的だ！報酬金と一緒にこれも持っていくといい。
One Thousand Meters Under#105.speaker: Scientist Ynnos

One Thousand Meters Under#106.dst: 任務の進み具合はいかがですか？
One Thousand Meters Under#106.speaker: The Secretary

One Thousand Meters Under#107.src: It looks like everyone already went inside the submarine.
One Thousand Meters Under#107.dst: 皆もう潜水艇に乗り込んだようだ。

One Thousand Meters Under#108.dst: インターホンがパチパチと音を立てて起動した…

One Thousand Meters Under#109.src: Looks like you managed to fix the pipe! You should tell the mechanic.
One Thousand Meters Under#109.dst: なんとかパイプを直せたようだ！整備士に伝えよう。

One Thousand Meters Under#110.src: Who would've thought that the crystal fell that far...
One Thousand Meters Under#110.dst: 水晶があんなに深くまで落ちてたなんて、誰が思うかよ…
One Thousand Meters Under#110.speaker: Manny

One Thousand Meters Under#111.src: But after all, there's still a lot ahead of us!
One Thousand Meters Under#111.dst: とはいえ、まだ先は長いぞ！
One Thousand Meters Under#111.speaker: Manny

One Thousand Meters Under#112.src: Have you looked around for the island for the crystal yet?
One Thousand Meters Under#112.dst: もう島で水晶を探したのか？
One Thousand Meters Under#112.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#113.src: If you haven't found anything, jump back in the submarine and I'll take us down to the next one.
One Thousand Meters Under#113.dst: 何も見つからなかったら、潜水艇に戻ってくれ。次の島まで潜るぞ。
One Thousand Meters Under#113.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#114.src: I've been hearing a lot of strange sounds...
One Thousand Meters Under#114.dst: 妙な音がたくさん聞こえるの…
One Thousand Meters Under#114.speaker: Arlene

One Thousand Meters Under#115.src: Pfft. I would've done a better job saving the windshield.
One Thousand Meters Under#115.dst: ふん。俺ならこうはならなかったよ。
One Thousand Meters Under#115.speaker: Jesp

One Thousand Meters Under#116.src: Too bad I was in another room.
One Thousand Meters Under#116.dst: 別の部屋にいたのが残念だ。
One Thousand Meters Under#116.speaker: Jesp

One Thousand Meters Under#117.src: Oh no, this isn't good. The windshield is destroyed...
One Thousand Meters Under#117.dst: ああ、まずいな。フロントガラスが割られた…
One Thousand Meters Under#117.speaker: Kantor

One Thousand Meters Under#118.src: I thought this trip was going to be easy.
One Thousand Meters Under#118.dst: 楽な旅になると思ってたのに。
One Thousand Meters Under#118.speaker: Kantor

One Thousand Meters Under#120.src: This sand must've fallen from the sky islands, but why is it red?
One Thousand Meters Under#120.dst: この砂はSky Islandsから落ちてきたんだろうが、なんで赤いんだ？
One Thousand Meters Under#120.speaker: Manny

One Thousand Meters Under#122.src: It smells really...sterile? Does this mean I have to work...?
One Thousand Meters Under#122.dst: なんだか…消毒臭い？ってことは、働かなきゃいけないのか…？
One Thousand Meters Under#122.speaker: Kantor

One Thousand Meters Under#123.src: We need this crystal. Go see Rontaid on the eastern part of the island, he can figure something out.
One Thousand Meters Under#123.dst: わしたちには水晶が必要だ。島の東にいる Rontaid に会え、何とかしてくれるよ。
One Thousand Meters Under#123.speaker: Celuuse

One Thousand Meters Under#124.src: I hope you make use of our science.
One Thousand Meters Under#124.dst: 我々の科学を役立ててくれ。
One Thousand Meters Under#124.speaker: Rontaid

One Thousand Meters Under#125.src: We don't want another village to fall down here... I'm not sure we could provide for even more people.
One Thousand Meters Under#125.dst: 村がこれ以上落ちてくるのはごめんだ…これ以上の人数を養えるか分からない。
One Thousand Meters Under#125.speaker: Rontaid

One Thousand Meters Under#126.src: Looks like the backup team have lowered a crane down to the island, this is your way out!
One Thousand Meters Under#126.dst: 救援隊が島までクレーンを下ろしてくれたようだ、これで脱出できる！

One Thousand Meters Under#127.src: I'm working on a replacement for the crystal now...
One Thousand Meters Under#127.dst: 今、水晶の代わりを作っているところだ…
One Thousand Meters Under#127.speaker: Scientist Ynnos

One Thousand Meters Under#128.src: These void villagers are rather smart, but their handwriting is utterly atrocious.
One Thousand Meters Under#128.dst: 虚無の村人たちはなかなか賢いが、字が実にひどい。
One Thousand Meters Under#128.speaker: Scientist Ynnos

One Thousand Meters Under#129.src: The crystal you're looking for is purple, not blue.
One Thousand Meters Under#129.dst: 探している水晶は青じゃなくて紫だ。

One Thousand Meters Under#130.src: You probably could've seen that from the other side.
One Thousand Meters Under#130.dst: それなら反対側からでも見えたかもしれない。
